name: Screen brightness
plain: Reads the screen brightness setting with no prompt.
meaning: Reveals indoor or outdoor use and whether the person left auto-brightness. Mostly a context hint.

android.note: Readable with no permission; writing needs WRITE_SETTINGS

ios.api_surface: Read and write; writes revert at app exit, no ambient lux API

limits.headline: Can check your screen brightness with no prompt, and change it while the app is open
limits.user_action: Nothing to check it. You tap a feature like Full brightness for a ticket or code
can: See your brightness level, from 0 to 255 on Android
See if brightness is set to automatic on Android
Change brightness for its own screen on iPhone while the app is open
Change brightness system wide on Android, if you allow Modify system settings
cannot: Change Android system brightness without the special Modify system settings switch
Keep a changed brightness on iPhone after you leave the app; it goes back
See the light level in the room on iPhone; no public sensor reading exists
limits.differs: Android needs a special settings switch to change brightness for everything. On iPhone a change reverts when the app closes.

story.what_it_is: An app can read how bright your screen is set.
story.for_you: You never see this check. A brightness reading can hint at whether you are outside in the sun, in bed at night or in a dark room.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to adapt colors, show dark mode hints and boost readability. It is a small context signal, rarely used alone for tracking.

use_cases.example: A video app switches to dark theme when brightness is very low at night.
A running app boosts text contrast when brightness is high outdoors.
A photo editor warns that colors may look wrong because the screen is very dim.
An AR game raises its overlay contrast in bright sun so you can still see targets.
A reading app suggests larger text when brightness is low.
An ad firm adds brightness to a list of device details for time and place guesses.

story.android_note: Read as a system setting with no prompt.
story.ios_note: Read through UIScreen brightness with no prompt.

technical_bounds: iOS apps cannot read the ambient light sensor, only brightness
